web.title: Hyper3D Rodin AI 3D Asset Generator Gen 1.5 Officially Launches
web.description:
**WEST LOS ANGELES, Calif. – April 29, 2025** – Deemos Tech, the innovative company behind the popular 3D modeling tool [Hyper3D](https://hyper3d.ai/), today announced the official launch of **Hyper3D Rodin AI 3D Asset Generator Gen 1.5**, its new native 3D generative AI model.

## Hyper3D Rodin AI 3D Generator
Deemos Tech’s Hyper3D Rodin represents a substantial leap forward in native 3D AI model generation, evolving from the foundational success of its predecessor, Hyper3D.
